title: BellowsKV: One Latent for Many Layers, Expanded on Demand
abstract: arXiv:2610.35023v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) now serve as the backbone of agents that reason over many turns, call tools, and pursue long-horizon tasks. To avoid recomputation, a model stores the attention keys and values of all past tokens in a key-value (KV) cache. Each layer maintains its own cache, so KV-cache memory can become the main bottleneck for GPU serving. Most compression methods operate within a single layer, by quantizing the cache entries, reducing the channel dimension, or evicting less important tokens. All three lose substantial accuracy at high compression ratios. Cross-layer methods share one compressed cache across adjacent layers to go beyond this limit. However, these methods also degrade sharply at high compression ratios. We find that the KV-cache representations of adjacent layers are quite different, whereas the input hidden states of adjacent layers are highly similar. translated_title: BellowsKV：一个潜变量服务于多个层，按需展开
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）如今已成为智能体的骨干，这些智能体需要进行多轮推理、调用工具并执行长周期任务。为了避免重复计算，模型将所有历史 token 的注意力键和值存储在键值缓存中。每一层都维护着自己的缓存，因此 KV 缓存内存可能成为 GPU 推理服务的主要瓶颈。大多数压缩方法在单个层内进行操作，即通过量化缓存条目、降低通道维度或驱逐不重要的 token 来压缩缓存。这三种方法在高压缩比下都会损失大量精度。跨层方法通过在相邻层之间共享一个压缩缓存来突破这一限制，然而这些方法在高压缩比下同样会急剧退化。我们发现，相邻层的 KV 缓存表示差异很大，而相邻层的输入隐状态却高度相似。我们还发现，在相同的内存预算下，减少（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 BellowsKV，基于“相邻层输入隐状态高度相似而 KV 缓存差异较大”的发现，让多个层共享一个按需展开的潜变量表示，从而突破现有单层与跨层 KV 缓存压缩方法在高压缩比下的精度瓶颈。
en_tdlr: BellowsKV shares a single latent representation across many layers—exploiting the finding that adjacent layers' input hidden states are highly similar while their KV-cache representations differ greatly—and expands it on demand to overcome the accuracy limits of existing single-layer and cross-layer KV cache compression at high compression ratios.
